media.alt: High school students dive into healthcare simulation: CIME and SPIE Workshop

content.text: CIME in collaboration with the Society for Promoting Innovation in Education (SPIE) and the Office of the Registrar organised a cutting-edge Simulation in Action Workshop for high school students as part of the AKU's Pre-University Summer School Programme.

We are thrilled to share that 42 enthusiastic students actively participated in this engaging workshop. Designed with the aim of providing a hands-on experience in healthcare simulation, it allowed students to delve into the fascinating world of healthcare education and gain practical insights that will not only shape their future but also contribute to developing healthcare simulationists for tomorrow.

At CIME, we believe in empowering the next generation with practical skills and experiences that broaden their horizons. This workshop perfectly embodied that mission, offering students a unique opportunity to explore the intricacies of healthcare simulation first-hand.
